history.period: Ancient; claimed origins range from 3rd century BC (Maurya) to 5th century AD (Gupta) - verify
history.summary: Badi Patan Devi is the oldest and one of the most sacred temples of Patna, regarded as one of the 51 Siddha Shakti Peethas: Puranic legend holds that the right thigh (and cloth) of Devi Sati fell here in Magadha when severed by Vishnu's Sudarshan Chakra, hence the name 'Patan' (from 'pata'). The name of the city Patna is widely believed to derive from this temple, though some scholars dispute this, deriving Patna from 'patan' meaning a town. The sanctum houses black stone standing idols of Mahakali, Mahalakshmi and Mahasaraswati with Vyom Bhairav (Shiva), a large havan kunda before the sanctum, and a strange stone image found in a nearby tank now kept in the eastern veranda. A sister shrine, Chhoti Patan Devi, stands in the Chowk area. The exact age is uncertain: one source claims 5th-century Gupta origins, another 3rd-century BC Maurya origins (conflict flagged).

name: Badi Patan Devi Temple
town_description: Patna, the capital of Bihar on the southern bank of the Ganges, is among the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities - the ancient Pataliputra, capital of the Mauryan and Gupta empires. The Badi Patan Devi temple stands in the Maharajganj/Chowk area of Patna City (old Patna), east of Patna Railway Junction and south-east of the Sikh shrine Takht Sri Harmandir Sahib. Patna today is a major administrative, educational and religious centre with a 2011 population of about 1.7 million.

travel.airport: Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, Patna, approx. 10 km west; taxis and app cabs available.
travel.railway: Patna Junction approx. 3-4 km west; Patna City station also nearby; auto-rickshaws and city buses serve the area.
travel.road: In the Maharajganj/Chowk area of Patna City (old Patna), reached through narrow city lanes; east of Patna Railway Junction.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather. Navratri is the most vibrant period, though it draws large crowds.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open daily, generally morning to evening (verify exact timings - not stated in the sources consulted). The surrounding area is congested; footwear and modest dress required inside.
